FIX WAVE COMPLETE + ROLLOUT LANDED (2026-07-27 ~07:15). daemonkit v0.20.10 released (1d55b2a, signed, CI green, Latest ok): ErrPeerGone dead-peer classification (100003 + errSecCSNoSuchCode at all three Sec* sites, verifier-child peer_gone protocol, wire/server quiet tier) + Swift deadline-semantics fix (poll expiry no longer mislabeled EAGAIN; provesSessionTransition no longer counts it as teardown; retire+replay on open deadlines; ReadinessNoProgressError preserved — sol finder caught 2 major defects in round 2, both fixed with revert-proof e2e tests) + reportBridgeFailure stderr visibility. captain-hook v12.20.13 released (2236508): d66aaa4 gate split (absent-host vs slow-host) + daemonkit pins to 0.20.10 across all FOUR sites — including helper/project.yml exactVersion, WHICH HAD SAT AT 0.20.0 FOR NINE RELEASES: every shipped signed app carried 5-month-old daemonkit Swift; the field bridge failures persisted across upgrades because no fix ever reached the installed helper.
Local rollout: brew 12.20.13; package-install blocked by NEW P1 39ffc87 (quiesce catch-22: current() compares prior RuntimeBuild to installer Build — every in-place upgrade of a live runtime is impossible; plus exact-absence race: clients respawn the prior generation within 1-2s). Landed via: bootout + chmod-000 lockdown (passed quiesce; died at codesign read) -> chmod 444 (died at sealed-activation tamper check) -> chmod 755 restore + pkill + fresh package-install: SUCCESS. App 12.20.13, host+helper launchd agents pid-up exit-0, helper ok=True (bridge connected), live session hooks flowing, fresh log 0 bytes/0 flood lines (82MB flood log archived as capt-hookd.log.pre-v12.20.13). Bugs 6215482, 191e5724, d66aaa4 closed with criteria met + evidence. Open follow-ups: 39ffc87 (P1 upgrade path), 0ef22da (install verb no-op), plugin-cache CLI still 12.20.9 (separate artifact, updates via marketplace).
